reviewers.method: Role: exercise form (independent; no prior reviews, watch exports or p18 folders opened). For all 77 clips I viewed the revision-715283f4ef6b contact sheet (front/threequarter/left/right x 8 phases; 16 phases for kb-getup), and opened native 480x480 frames where a judgment depended on grip, contact or overlap (e.g. goblet-squat, kb-upright-row, kb-bent-row, kb-halo, kb-clean, kb-getup, bicycle-crunches, chin-ups, pull-ups, overhead-reach, cross-body-shoulder, quad-stretch, hip-flexor-lunge). I read the clip JSON (joint tracks, bells, hand states, grips, scene props, contract, validator) and used scratch scripts to measure joint positions/angles at sampled phases (elbow paths, depth, contralateral pairing, side alternation, flight frames, hand-to-target distances). Contracts: tools/animation/contracts.json; rubric: skills/exercise-animation SKILL.md + references/review-rubric.md + form-contracts.md; geometry.json for validator/clearance notes. The S/K/H source-ID-to-URL map is not in spamset-app, so contract sources were not individually opened. Primary pages opened where a cue was in doubt: ACE Supine Bicycle Crunches (https://www.acefitness.org/resources/everyone/exercise-library/241/supine-bicycle-crunches/, Step 2: trunk rotates to drive the elbow toward the opposite knee); Mayo Clinic 'A guide to basic stretches' (https://www.mayoclinic.org/healthy-lifestyle/fitness/in-depth/stretching/art-20546848, cross-body: hold the arm with the other arm above or below the elbow). NHS flexibility page (https://www.nhs.uk/live-well/exercise/flexibility-exercises/) was opened but has no cross-body/triceps stretch; no ACE upright-row page could be found, so the upright-row judgment rests on the contract text ('lift close to body; elbows below shoulders'). NOT run: real-time playback - timing, smoothness and loop continuity were judged only from 'duration', frame counts and per-frame joint data; no interactive orbit beyond the four fixed capture views. Scores are editorial AI judgments, not professional certification.

kb-swing.summary: Reads as a two-hand hip-hinge swing: bell travels back between/behind the thighs at the backswing (0.000, left/right), hips drive to standing, bell floats to about chest height on long arms (0.375-0.625), then returns to the hinge. Shared handle grip and planted feet throughout.

defects.issue: Forearms intersect the inner thighs by ~16 mm at the deepest backswing (geometry.json); reads as arms buried in the legs rather than the upper arms brushing the inner thighs.
defects.fix: Widen the stance or the bell path slightly at the backswing so the forearms pass between the thighs (bring hands ~2 cm medial / hips ~2 cm wider).

kb-deadlift.summary: Bell starts on the floor between the feet, both hands on the handle; hip hinge with soft knees to a tall lockout (0.5), then hinge and set the bell back on the floor. Bell stays attached and avoids the floor except at the reset.

defects.issue: Floor position uses quite a lot of knee flexion (thighs near 45 deg); still a hinge but drifts toward a squat-lift look.
defects.fix: Keep the setup shins more vertical: move hips ~5 cm higher/back at the floor phase while keeping the bell under the shoulders.

goblet-squat.summary: Bell held upright at the chest by the horns (palms wrapping both horns, threequarter 0.5 native frame), coherent squat to about parallel with feet planted and knees tracking the toes; returns to tall stance.

kb-reverse-lunge.summary: Goblet hold maintained; alternating rearward steps with a planted front foot, rear knee lowers toward the floor (0.25 and 0.75), rise and return to feet together before switching. Both sides shown.

kb-side-lunge.summary: Wide stance, bell at chest; shifts into one bent knee with the other leg long (0.25), returns to centre, then the other side (0.75). Both feet stay planted.

defects.issue: Torso stays almost upright; 'sit back' into the hip is weakly shown so the move reads partly as a knee bend.
defects.fix: Add ~15-20 deg of forward trunk lean and push the pelvis further back over the working heel at the bottom.

kb-upright-row.summary: Recognizable two-hand lift to the lower chest, but the path is not an upright row: the bell hangs ~20 cm in front of the thighs at the start and the elbows travel forward rather than up-and-out.

defects.issue: Arms angle forward; wrists ~20 cm ahead of the thighs (z=204 mm) so the bell is not 'close to the body' at the start.
defects.fix: Let the arms hang straight with the bell touching the front of the thighs (wrist z ~60-80 mm).

defects.issue: Elbows finish ~27 cm in FRONT of the shoulders at shoulder height (elbow z=281); reads like a front raise/high pull, not elbows leading up and out to the sides.
defects.fix: Drive elbows laterally: target elbow z close to shoulder z (~0-60 mm), elbow height just below the shoulder, and keep the bell sliding up within ~5-8 cm of the torso.

kb-bent-row.summary: Left-arm row from a staggered flat-back hinge; right hand rests on the front (right) thigh; elbow drives back past the torso so the bell reaches the hip (0.5) and lowers under control.

defects.issue: Support elbow flares far out (elbow x ~-353 mm) and the hand state is 'free', so from the front the support hand reads as on the hip rather than braced on the thigh.
defects.fix: Use hand state flat on the thigh and bring the support elbow in (~-250 mm) with the palm just above the right knee.

kb-side-bend.summary: Bell in the left hand, right hand on the hip; trunk bends toward the bell side with the loaded arm hanging straight and the bell sliding down the outer thigh toward the knee (0.5), then returns tall.

kb-curl.summary: Horns grip, bell in front of the thighs, elbows stay just in front of the hips while the bell curls to the chest (0.5) and lowers slowly.

defects.issue: Mid-curl the elbow drifts forward ~5 cm and the bell swings ~29 cm ahead of the torso; small but visible.
defects.fix: Pin elbow z within ~2 cm of the start and let the forearm alone arc the bell.

kb-halo.summary: Horns grip, bell base up at chin, circles round the head (sides at ear level, behind the head base down with elbows high at 0.25/0.75) and the second circle reverses direction. Torso and feet steady.

defects.issue: In the transition to the side the bell passes directly in front of the face and hides the head, so the 'around the head' path is ambiguous from this angle.
defects.fix: Route the bell ~8-10 cm higher and more lateral (past the temple) between the front reset and the side.

kb-clean.summary: Single-arm (left) clean: rack with the bell outside the forearm, drop into hinge, backswing between the legs (0.46), hip drive, elbow pulls back and the hand comes around the bell into a soft rack.

kb-press.summary: Strict single-arm press from the rack: forearm vertical as the bell passes the face (0.24), lockout with the arm by the ear and the bell on the back of the forearm (0.36-0.6), controlled lowering to the rack. Legs do not drive.

kb-snatch.summary: Lockout, bell turns over and drops into the backswing between the legs (0.48), hip drive, high pull with elbow high and out (0.71), punch through to lockout. Reads as a snatch, distinct from the clean.

defects.issue: On the drop the bell is cast far out in front (~48 cm ahead of the torso), making the descent look like a front-raise arc rather than a guided drop close to the body.
defects.fix: Keep the bell within ~25-30 cm of the torso on the drop by bending the elbow slightly before the arm lengthens into the backswing.

kb-getup.summary: Full Turkish get-up and reverse: supine press, roll to elbow, post on the hand, high bridge (0.19), leg sweep to half-kneel, upright lunge, step up to standing (0.5) and every step reversed. Bell arm stays vertical throughout.

defects.issue: Rising from the lunge, the lifter shifts forward and holds a single-leg partial squat on the front leg while the back foot swings up; reads as a dip/pistol rather than standing up through the front leg.
defects.fix: Drive the pelvis up toward ~850-900 mm while the back toes are still down, then step the back foot forward from a near-tall position.

defects.issue: 'Eyes on the bell' is hard to confirm; the face mostly points forward/down.
defects.fix: Rotate the head to look up at the bell in the supine, roll and bridge stages.

kb-pullover.summary: Bell upside down at the chest on the horns; carried over the head with bent elbows, lowered behind the head (0.5), and returned over the head to the chest. Ribs stay down; feet planted.

squat.summary: Hips back and down with both soles planted, knees tracking the feet, arms reaching forward as a counterbalance; returns to tall stance. Comfortable depth near parallel.

wall-pushup.summary: Palms flat on the wall at chest height, whole-body lean from planted feet, elbows bend to bring the chest toward the wall (0.375-0.625) and press away. Wall prop present in every view.

calf-raise.summary: Heels rise while the forefeet stay grounded, brief top hold (0.375-0.625), heels lower. Body rises as a unit.

defects.issue: Heel lift is modest and hard to see from the front, where the move looks almost static.
defects.fix: Increase heel height ~20-30% at the top, or rely on a side default camera so the forefoot pivot is visible.

shoulder-circle.summary: Upper-body view of a backward shoulder roll: the shoulder girdle travels forward, up, back and down (~7 cm fore-aft, ~9 cm vertical in the joint data) while the arms hang loosely; reads best from left/right views.

defects.issue: From the front the circle collapses into a small shrug; the backward component is invisible.
defects.fix: Keep the default camera at a side/three-quarter azimuth (current default 60 deg is appropriate).

reverse-lunge.summary: Alternating rearward steps: front sole stays fixed, rear foot lands on the forefoot, rear knee lowers toward the floor (0.25/0.75), rise and return to feet together before switching legs.

pushup.summary: High plank from the toes, palms under the shoulders, aligned trunk; elbows bend about 45 deg from the body to lower the chest and press back up. Palms and forefeet stay grounded.

defects.issue: Bottom position stops with the shoulders ~36 cm above the floor; depth is moderate rather than chest-near-floor.
defects.fix: Optional: lower the chest a further ~6-8 cm at the bottom to make the full-range variant explicit.

wide-pushup.summary: Hands placed clearly wider than the shoulders (palm x 370 mm vs shoulder 190 mm), same aligned plank and press; distinct from the standard push-up in the front view.

close-pushup.summary: Hands close together under the chest, elbows stay inside the shoulders and travel back along the ribs at the bottom (front 0.5) as the contract specifies.

staggered-pushup.summary: One hand ~28 cm ahead of the other (left forward), push-up with both palms grounded; the stagger is visible in left/right and threequarter views.

stacked-pushup.summary: Right foot rests on top of the left heel; only the lower forefoot contacts the floor; standard lower and press.

defects.issue: The stacked feet are hidden behind the torso in the front view, so that camera does not identify the variant.
defects.fix: None needed in motion; keep the default side camera (az 80).

raised-leg-pushup.summary: One straight leg lifts during the lower-and-press (0.125-0.375), returns, then the other leg on the next rep (0.625-0.875). Supporting forefoot and palms grounded.

spiderman-pushup.summary: As the chest lowers, one knee draws out to the side toward the same-side elbow (0.25), returns on the press; the other side follows (0.75). Both sides shown.

decline-pushup.summary: Feet on the chair seat, palms on the floor, straight body angled down; lower and press. Chair prop clear in every side view.

defects.issue: Feet rest near the front edge of the seat with the toes barely on it; the seat contact is easy to miss at small size.
defects.fix: Place the forefeet ~8-10 cm further onto the seat.

clapping-pushup.summary: Lower, explosive press so the hands leave the floor, hands meet for a clap under the chest (0.625 front), land and reset. Forefeet stay grounded.

defects.issue: Hands stay airborne for ~0.73 s (22 frames at 30 fps), a slow-motion flight; the clap is only visible in roughly one sampled phase.
defects.fix: Shorten the flight to ~0.35-0.45 s and hold the clap contact ~0.1 s at the apex so it reads at playback speed.

power-pushup.summary: Same explosive lower-and-press with the hands leaving the floor at the apex (0.625) but no clap; landing and reset are coherent.

defects.issue: Nearly identical to clapping-pushup except the hands stay ~32 cm apart in flight; flight time (~0.8 s) is long.
defects.fix: Shorten flight to ~0.4 s; optionally show the hands lifting just clear of the floor to emphasise the difference from the clap variant.

pike-pushup.summary: Inverted V with palms and feet grounded; elbows bend to lower the head between the hands and press back. Identity is clear, but the range is small.

defects.issue: Head lowers only ~11 cm (219 -> 109 mm) and the hips sit fairly low (pelvis 800 mm), so the V is shallow and the press reads as a small bob.
defects.fix: Walk the feet ~15 cm closer to raise the hips (pelvis ~950 mm), start the head higher (~350 mm) and lower until it is ~5 cm above the floor in front of the hands.

defects.issue: Elbows flare ~21 cm outside the shoulders.
defects.fix: Keep elbows at ~45 deg (elbow x ~300 mm) so the press reads as overhead-pressing direction.

standing-knee.summary: Upright posture with alternating bent-knee lifts to about hip height (left at 0.25, right at 0.75); support foot fixed; each knee is replaced before the switch.

side-step.summary: True step-together: the left foot steps out while the right stays planted, then the right joins (0.25-0.5); the return leads with the right and the left follows (0.75-1.0). Only the swing foot leaves the floor.

glute-bridge.summary: Supine bent-knee setup, soles planted, hips lift to a straight shoulder-to-knee line (0.375-0.625) with head and upper back supported, then lower.

bird-dog.summary: Hands-and-knees setup; left arm with right leg reach and return (0.0-0.5), then right arm with left leg (0.5-1.0). Support palm and opposite knee stay fixed; trunk level.

defects.issue: The reaching arm sweeps low and forward along the floor before rising, so the arm briefly reads as sliding rather than lifting.
defects.fix: Lift the hand ~10 cm before extending forward (raise palm y earlier in the first 20% of the reach).

plank.summary: Static forearm plank from the toes, elbows under the shoulders, aligned head-to-heel line; correctly presented as a hold with no repetition motion.

sit-ups.summary: Bent-knee sit-up, hands behind the head, feet and pelvis on the floor; trunk curls up to near-upright (0.5) and lowers.

defects.issue: Validator flags dynamic balance (ZMP 0.066 m outside support) at the top; with unanchored feet the depicted torso position would tip back. Not a form-identity issue but the feet look unsupported.
defects.fix: Stop the curl ~10-15 deg short of vertical or bring the heels ~8 cm closer to the hips.

reverse-crunches.summary: Tabletop legs; knees curl toward the chest with the pelvis lifting ~10 cm off the floor (0.37-0.61), then lower back to tabletop. Back and arms stay on the floor.

bicycle-crunches.summary: Alternating knee-in with the opposite elbow, other leg extended and hovering; both sides shown. The teaching cue is weakened because the trunk does not rotate.

defects.issue: Chest and head are frozen (chest [0,229,-400] in every frame); only the arm lifts its elbow toward the knee, so it reads as an arm flap rather than a trunk twist bringing the shoulder across.
defects.fix: Rotate the upper trunk ~25-35 deg toward the driving knee at each side (move the opposite shoulder across and up) with the elbow following the shoulder.

defects.issue: Validator fails dynamic balance.
defects.fix: Lower the extended leg to ~25-30 cm and keep the shoulder blades just off the floor.

flutter-kicks.summary: Supine, legs hovering, small alternating straight-leg kicks; lower back and arms stay down.

leg-raises.summary: Supine straight-leg raise from a low hover to about 45 deg and back, legs together, arms flat on the floor.

superman.summary: Prone; arms and legs lift together with the belly and hips on the floor, hold (0.25-0.75), lower.

back-lifts.summary: Prone chest lift with hands by the temples; hips and legs stay on the floor; chest lifts and lowers. Small but clear range in side views.

alt-arm-leg-plank.summary: High plank, left arm with right leg reach and hold, return, then right arm with left leg. Contralateral pairing and both sides are correct, but the support looks unconvincing.

defects.issue: Feet stay narrow (x +-100 mm) and the torso does not shift onto the support hand; validator flags ZMP 0.144 m outside support, so the three-point hold looks like it would topple.
defects.fix: Widen the feet to ~+-200 mm for this move and shift the pelvis/chest ~5 cm toward the supporting hand during the reach.

defects.issue: On the return the arm folds with the forearm horizontal across the chest before planting, an odd extra pose.
defects.fix: Bring the hand back on a direct downward arc to its floor mark.

shoulder-taps.summary: High plank with feet apart; each hand lifts and taps the opposite shoulder (palm lands on the shoulder joint), replaces, then the other side. Hips stay level as coached.

defects.issue: No small weight shift onto the support arm; validator flags ZMP 0.136 m outside support.
defects.fix: Shift the chest 2-4 cm toward the support hand during each tap while keeping hips level.

climbers.summary: High plank with palms grounded; knees drive alternately toward the chest and return. Reads as mountain climbers from side views.

plank-jump-ins.summary: From high plank both feet jump in together to a crouch near the hands (0.25-0.5), then jump back out to plank. Palms stay grounded.

tricep-extensions.summary: Forearm plank, hands stay planted where the forearms were, press up onto straight arms (0.5) and lower back to the forearms. Forefeet grounded.

pseudo-planche.summary: High plank with hands under/behind the shoulders; shoulders lean ~25 cm forward past the hands (0.5), hold, and return. Forefeet grounded.

tricep-dips.summary: Floor dip: hands behind the hips, feet planted ahead, hips held off the floor; elbows bend backward to lower the hips ~10 cm and press up.

defects.issue: Range is modest (shoulders drop ~10 cm); the elbow bend is easy to miss at small size.
defects.fix: Increase the lower phase by ~4-5 cm of hip drop.

fly-steps.summary: Arms out in a T; hinge forward while lifting one straight leg behind (0.12-0.3), hold, return to standing, then the other leg (0.6-0.8). Standing foot planted. Chart-defined variant; no primary source to confirm.

side-leg-raises.summary: Upright stance; one straight leg lifts out to the side (~30 deg) and lowers, then the other side. Torso stays upright, standing foot planted.

punches.summary: Orthodox stance (left foot forward), fists guarding the face; jab with the lead arm (0.23), return to guard, cross with the rear arm with shoulder rotation and rear-heel pivot (0.58-0.7), return. Fist hand state throughout.

side-to-side-chops.summary: Straight arms in front with hands together sweep in a level arc ~40 deg to each side via trunk rotation, hips forward, feet planted, matching the generator's S54 summary (a horizontal chop, not a high-to-low woodchop).

defects.issue: Hands use the free state ~1 cm apart rather than clasped, so 'hands together' is implied, not shown.
defects.fix: Use an interlaced/clasped hand state or overlap the palms.

chest-expansions.summary: Arms open to a T at shoulder height, then cross in front of the chest (0.25, 0.75), alternating which arm crosses over; feet planted.

chin-ups.summary: Dead hang with an underhand, shoulder-width grip (grip w=-1, hands +-170 mm); pull until the head clears the bar (0.5) with elbows travelling forward, then lower to a straight-arm hang.

defects.issue: Head centre is only ~6 cm above the bar and 22 cm behind it; the chin reaches about bar height rather than clearly over it.
defects.fix: Raise the top by ~5 cm and bring the chest ~8 cm closer to the bar.

pull-ups.summary: Overhand grip wider than the shoulders (hands +-300 mm), dead hang, elbows drive down and out to pull the head over the bar, controlled lower. Clearly distinct from chin-ups in the front view.

defects.issue: Same as chin-ups: chin only reaches bar height and the body hangs well behind the bar.
defects.fix: Raise the top ~5 cm and move the upper chest toward the bar.

doorframe-rows.summary: Feet in the doorway, hands gripping both sides of the frame at chest height, straight-body lean back with long arms (0.0), row the chest toward the frame (0.5), lower. Chart-defined; no primary source to confirm.

sit-stand.summary: Seated with the pelvis on the seat, arms reach forward as the trunk leans, rise to full standing (0.5), controlled sit back down with a seated pause; no arm support.

seated-knee.summary: Sitting tall, pelvis on the seat; left bent knee lifts ~19 cm and lowers (0.25), then the right (0.75). Other foot stays on the floor.

defects.issue: The foot drifts ~17 cm forward as the knee lifts, so the shin tilts and hints at a kick-out.
defects.fix: Keep the ankle under the knee (shin near vertical) during the lift.

db-curl.summary: Bilateral standing curl: upper arms stay at the sides (elbows fixed at the hips), dumbbells follow the forearm arcs to shoulder height (0.5) and lower; dumbbell models stay in the hands throughout.

band-pull.summary: Arms start straight ahead at shoulder height holding the band, open out to the sides so the band stretches across the chest (0.375-0.625), and return. Band endpoints stay fixed in the hands.

neck-flexion.summary: Upper-body view; chin lowers toward the chest, hold (0.25-0.625), lift back to neutral. Shoulders and trunk still.

neck-extension.summary: Upper-body view; head tilts back to look up, hold, return to neutral. Trunk still.

side-neck.summary: Front upper-body view; ear tilts toward the left shoulder with a hold, returns, then toward the right; shoulders stay level.

overhead-reach.summary: Arms sweep out and up overhead, hold, and lower; the general stretch is present but the top position does not match the named variant.

defects.issue: At the hold the elbows stay bent ~40 deg (elbow angle ~140 deg) and the hands cross at the wrists in an X (palm_l x=-25, palm_r x=+25, free hand state) instead of interlacing fingers with straight arms pressing up.
defects.fix: Straighten the arms to ~170 deg with the hands stacked over the crown and use an interlaced/clasped hand state (palms up) at the hold.

defects.issue: The arms travel through a wide T before rising, which reads like a lateral raise.
defects.fix: Optional: bring the hands together in front first and raise them overhead in the sagittal plane.

triceps-stretch.summary: One side shown: the left elbow lifts above the head with the hand dropping behind the upper back, the right hand reaches over and rests on the raised elbow (palm ~8 cm from the elbow), hold (0.33-0.6), release. Feet planted.

defects.issue: The stretching arm lifts straight forward to horizontal first, a detour that briefly looks like a front raise.
defects.fix: Lift the arm via a direct overhead path (elbow rising beside the ear).

cross-body-shoulder.summary: One side shown: left arm crosses the chest and is held at the hold phase; identity is clear, but the supporting hand is not holding the arm.

defects.issue: The right forearm hooks over the left upper arm while the right hand floats ~20 cm above it at chin height (palm [52,1486] vs left elbow [-37,1274]); the contract and Mayo Clinic's guide say to hold the arm with the other hand above or below the elbow.
defects.fix: Place the right palm on the back of the left arm just above the elbow (hand state flat/grip) and let the right elbow point down.

behind-back-clasp.summary: Hands meet behind the hips, straight arms lift back and up (~17 cm), chest opens with a slight head lift, hold, release.

defects.issue: Hands use the free state ~1.4 cm apart; 'fingers interlinked' is implied rather than shown.
defects.fix: Use a clasped/interlaced hand state at the hold.

torso-extension.summary: Hands on hips, gentle lean back (pelvis forward ~6 cm, head back ~21 cm at 0.5) and return without a long hold. Feet planted.

side-bend.summary: Right arm reaches overhead as the trunk bends to the left (chest shifts ~16 cm, hips level), returns, then the mirror side with the left arm. Both feet planted.

oblique-twist.summary: Hands together at chest height with elbows out; shoulders rotate ~55 deg left, return, then right, while the hips stay square and feet planted.

cat-cow.summary: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips; back rounds with the head down (cat, 0.125-0.25), returns, then belly sinks with the head up (cow, 0.625-0.75).

defects.issue: Spinal flexion/extension amplitude is modest; at small size the cat and cow mostly read through the head.
defects.fix: Increase mid-back rise/sag by ~3-4 cm.

quad-stretch.summary: Standing on the right leg, the left heel is drawn to the glute with the left hand holding the ankle, knee pointing down; free arm out for balance; hold and release.

hamstring-stretch.summary: Front (left) leg nearly straight with the heel down and toes up, back knee bent, hips hinge forward with hands on the front thigh; hold and return. Both feet on the floor.

hip-flexor-lunge.summary: Half-kneeling: left knee down, right foot forward, upright trunk; pelvis shifts forward ~12 cm into the stretch, hold, return. Hands on the front knee.

reclined-twist.summary: Supine knee rolls viewed from the feet: knees together roll to one side and back, then the other, while shoulders and outstretched arms stay flat on the floor.

reviewers.method: Read figure.ts, hand-model.ts, equipment-model.ts, figure-viewer.tsx framing code, design/visual-tokens.json and src/constants/theme.ts. Viewed all 77 contact sheets (front/threequarter/left/right x 8 phases; 16 for kb-getup) and opened native 480x480 frames where detail mattered (hands, grips, overlaps, framing, clipping). Read geometry.json (validator v2, limb/bell clearances) and computed from assets/animations/*.json the loop seam, per-frame max joint step (pops/snaps), still fraction and pairwise clip differences (e.g. clapping vs power push-up). Real-time playback was NOT observed: pacing and loop seams are judged from duration and per-frame joint data only, so timing/smoothness review is partial. Captures use fixed orbit views, not each clip's default camera; I scored the worst readable cost across orbit angles but weighted the app default view (clip `view`) as the primary teaching view. PSX mode not inspected.

alt-arm-leg-plank.summary: Side and three-quarter views show the opposite arm and leg reach from a high plank. Transitions look tangled: the reaching arm folds across the support arm, and the head-on view gives no read. Validator v2 flags ZMP 0.144 m outside support.

defects.issue: While the arm returns, the forearm folds horizontally across the support arm under the face; the two arms form a cross and it is unclear which hand is on the floor.
defects.fix: Route the returning hand outside the support arm (path 8-10 cm lateral) and keep the elbow down while it lowers.

defects.issue: Head-on view: the extended arm points at the camera and the lifted leg hides behind the torso; nothing reads.
defects.fix: Geometry only; keep the default az 66.

defects.issue: Balance validator failure means the body visibly lacks a weight shift onto the support side.
defects.fix: Shift the pelvis and chest 5-8 cm toward the support hand/foot diagonal before lifting.

back-lifts.summary: A prone chest lift with hands at temples. The lift is small in a figure that is a thin horizontal strip at phone size, and the front view (from the feet) is unreadable: legs appear end-on as two blocks with elbows as wings.

defects.issue: Chest lift of roughly 10 cm on a figure ~25 px tall in the sheet; at native size the action is a slight bump.
defects.fix: Frame floor-lying clips tighter (they use full-length bounds): reduce distance or crop the empty space above; a 10-15 deg higher default elevation also helps.

defects.issue: Viewed from the feet the legs are end-on blobs and the head hides behind the shoulders.
defects.fix: Geometry only, but consider a minimum elevation of ~20 deg for prone clips so the back line shows from any azimuth.

defects.issue: Hands at temples are mitten clumps that merge with the head.
defects.fix: Spread elbows slightly wider and keep fingertips (mitten tips) just behind the ears so the head silhouette stays clear.

band-pull.summary: The lime band and pull-apart at chest height read very clearly from the front; three-quarter is good. The band is a straight tube that lies along the arms in the three-quarter view.

defects.issue: At full pull-apart the band runs along/through the near arm and chest line, merging with the arms.
defects.fix: Offset the band 3-4 cm forward of the hands (ends in the palms, middle in front of the sternum) so it stays separate from the arms.

defects.issue: Band is end-on and the arms overlap; expected.
defects.fix: None.

behind-back-clasp.summary: Side and three-quarter views show straight arms lifting behind the back; front view shows almost nothing because the hands are behind the body. Clasped hands are two free mittens touching, not a recognizable clasp.

defects.issue: Arms and hands are entirely hidden behind the torso; the stretch is invisible from the front.
defects.fix: Geometry only; keep default az 52.

defects.issue: The clasp reads as a small blob at the far side of the hips.
defects.fix: Add a clasp hand state (interlocked mittens facing each other) or use the grip state around a virtual bar between the palms.

defects.issue: Palm moves 67-80 mm in a single frame when the hands meet/release, a visible pop.
defects.fix: Ease the clasp/release over 3-4 frames.

bicycle-crunches.summary: Side and three-quarter views show opposite elbow to knee with alternating legs; readable. Front view (from the feet) is a stack of legs. ZMP validator failure.

defects.issue: From the feet the lifted thighs hide the torso; only knees and one elbow show.
defects.fix: Geometry only.

defects.issue: Twisting elbow and bent knee cross in one tangle near the chest; which elbow meets which knee is hard to tell at phone size.
defects.fix: Hold the rotation peak 2-3 frames longer and keep the opposite (straight) leg 5 cm lower so the contrast of bent vs extended leg is stronger.

defects.issue: Floor disc is wider than the frame and is cut at the side.
defects.fix: Clamp floor disc radius to the framed width or frame with the disc included.

bird-dog.summary: Quadruped with alternating contralateral reach is clear in three-quarter and side views; flat hands and knees on the floor read. Front view is the usual head-on stack.

defects.issue: During the reach the far arm (grey) against the floor disc is low contrast.
defects.fix: Slightly lighten far-limb grey or darken the floor disc to separate grey limbs from the disc.

calf-raise.summary: Heel raise is visible in side views at native size; front and three-quarter show only a slight body rise. In profile the near arm covers the whole torso, leaving the figure a thin column.

defects.issue: Heel lift reads only as a small vertical bob.
defects.fix: Keep side as default; consider increasing the default elevation to 10-12 deg so the shoe tilt shows in 3/4.

defects.issue: Near arm hangs over the torso so the shirt is just an orange edge; silhouette is a stick.
defects.fix: Hang the arms 2-3 cm forward of the trunk midline or slightly abducted so the torso shape shows.

cat-cow.summary: The round (cat) and arch (cow) are clear in side views thanks to the split shirt hull; head drops and lifts with the spine. Front view is a head-on stack.

defects.issue: At full cat the head drops behind the near arm and the face disappears.
defects.fix: Limit head flexion so the crown stays just below shoulder level instead of tucked behind the arm.

chest-expansions.summary: Arms open wide and cross in front of the chest, alternating which arm is on top; front and three-quarter are clear. Quick pacing (3 s) fits the move.

defects.issue: Crossed forearms at the chest form a small knot; which arm is on top is hard to read.
defects.fix: Cross slightly lower (sternum, not collarbone) and a few cm further forward so the near arm separates from the chest.

chin-ups.summary: Hang to chin-over-bar on a pull-up frame reads well from the front. In side views the near frame post slices through the figure and hides the hands. Almost indistinguishable from pull-ups at phone size.

defects.issue: The vertical post is drawn through the middle of the body, and the bar is end-on, so the grip and pull are hidden behind a line.
defects.fix: Place the posts at least 10 cm behind the hanging plane (z offset) or make the frame posts thinner/darker than the figure outline.

defects.issue: The underhand grip is not readable; only grip width differs from pull-ups.
defects.fix: Turn the palms visibly toward the face (show the thumb on the outside) and keep a clearly narrower grip (shoulder width vs 1.5x for pull-ups).

defects.issue: Head at the top is ~30 px from the frame edge and partly behind the bar.
defects.fix: Add 5% top margin for hanging clips.

clapping-pushup.summary: Push-up mechanics are clear in side views, but the clap is visible in only one captured phase and the clip is identical to power-pushup except for about 25 of 90 frames (0.8 s); at phone size the two are hard to tell apart.

defects.issue: The clap is brief and occurs under the chest where the hands are partly hidden by the torso.
defects.fix: Lengthen the airborne phase by 4-6 frames and bring the clap forward to under the face, palms meeting vertically so the touch is visible from the side.

defects.issue: Except during flight the clip matches power-pushup frame for frame.
defects.fix: Give the clapping variant a visibly higher hand lift and a held clap; differentiate the descents only if form allows.

climbers.summary: Mountain-climber knee drives read from three-quarter and side views; plank support stays planted. Knees nearly touch the upper arms and the head-on view is a tangle.

defects.issue: Driving knee comes within 6.5 mm of the upper arm and overlaps the support arm, hiding the knee position.
defects.fix: Drive the knee toward the chest midline (5 cm medial) rather than toward the elbow.

defects.issue: Head-on view shows arms and knees as one block.
defects.fix: Geometry only.

close-pushup.summary: Close-grip push-up with elbows tucked reads clearly in side and three-quarter views; the narrow hand position shows in front view. Distinct from wide and standard push-ups at the bottom.

defects.issue: Head-on bottom position shows only shoulders and hands; elbows behind the body are hidden.
defects.fix: Geometry only.

cross-body-shoulder.summary: The arm-across-chest stretch is clear in the front and three-quarter views. The close crop (cropBelow 0.98) puts the body at the frame edge in side views, cutting it off, and the stretching elbow pops at the start and end of the hold.

defects.issue: The torso is pushed to the right (left view) or left (right view) frame edge and cut by the frame; legs cut at the thighs.
defects.fix: Center the crop target on the chest instead of the bounds centre that includes the extended arm, or loosen the crop by ~20%.

defects.issue: elbow_r jumps 152 mm in one frame (frames 30-31 and the mirror at ~77-78) after a 40-60 mm/frame ramp; a visible snap when the helper hand engages.
defects.fix: Resample the arm path through the grab so per-frame displacement stays under ~60 mm, easing in over 4-5 frames.

defects.issue: Helper hand presses the forearm but is a grey mitten partly hidden behind the stretched arm.
defects.fix: Place the helper hand above the elbow on the near side of the stretched arm.

db-curl.summary: Bilateral dumbbell curl with orange-plated dumbbells reads well in front and three-quarter; elbows stay at the sides. Dumbbells are small but distinct.

defects.issue: At the top the dumbbells sit in front of the shoulders and the plates overlap the shirt edges.
defects.fix: Stop the curl ~3 cm lower or keep the forearms slightly forward so the dumbbells sit in front of the chest outline.

decline-pushup.summary: Feet on the chair seat and the decline push-up read clearly in three-quarter and side views; chair is well proportioned and outlined. Front view shows the chair behind the shoulders.

defects.issue: Chair frame and legs overlap the shoulders head-on, cluttering the bottom position.
defects.fix: Geometry only.

defects.issue: Chair back and seat are drawn as thin rails similar to the figure's outline, making the seat contact small at native size.
defects.fix: Thicken the seat slab edge a little or lighten the seat top so the foot contact shows.

doorframe-rows.summary: Leaning back from the door jambs and rowing in is clear in side views; grips on the jambs read. In the three-quarter view the near jamb runs straight through the torso, and the front view shows little depth change.

defects.issue: Near jamb is drawn over the torso and legs, splitting the figure in two and hiding the near hand's grip.
defects.fix: Move the jambs a few cm wider than the hands' grip points or make the near jamb partly transparent/thinner (like the see-through wall).

defects.issue: Lean-back and pull are along the camera axis; only small elbow flare changes.
defects.fix: Geometry only; keep default az 60.

flutter-kicks.summary: Small alternating leg kicks while supine read in side and three-quarter views, but the figure is a thin horizontal strip and the kick amplitude (~15-20 cm) is small at phone size; the front view is unreadable.

defects.issue: Legs separate only slightly; with near/far shading similar the two legs merge into one wedge.
defects.fix: Increase separation to ~25 cm at the feet and keep near/far shading contrast strong (near leg ivory pants, far darker).

defects.issue: Lying figure fills about 20% of the frame height; lots of empty space above.
defects.fix: Frame lying clips by their actual height (lower target and smaller distance) rather than the standing-height heuristic.

defects.issue: Seam step 28.9 mm equals the max per-frame step: continuous, but there is no ease at the loop point.
defects.fix: None required; verify in playback.

fly-steps.summary: Hinge with rear-leg lift and arms out alternates clearly; three-quarter and side views show a strong T-shaped silhouette. Front view also reads due to the wide arms.

defects.issue: The rear leg goes behind the standing leg and is hidden.
defects.fix: Geometry only.

glute-bridge.summary: Supine bridge with feet planted and arms flat reads cleanly in side and three-quarter views; hip lift is clear. Front view is from the feet and unreadable.

defects.issue: Shins and knees block everything.
defects.fix: Geometry only.

defects.issue: Figure is small for a floor move; flat hands are tiny stubs.
defects.fix: Tighter framing for floor clips (see cross-cutting).

goblet-squat.summary: Horns grip at the chest and the descent read well from front, three-quarter and sides; elbows stay inside the knees. Minor upper-arm/thigh touch at the bottom.

defects.issue: Upper arms brush the thighs (-1 mm) and the far hand/horn grip is hidden behind the bell; hands read as grey stubs on the bell.
defects.fix: Lift the elbows 1-2 cm at the bottom and rotate the bell slightly so both mittens wrap visibly on the horns from the default view.

hamstring-stretch.summary: Heel-down, toes-up front foot and the hip hinge with hands on the thigh read in side views. In front view the hinge is a slight lean and the lifted toes are invisible.

defects.issue: Hinge points at the camera so it reads as a slight slouch.
defects.fix: Geometry only; default az 48 is reasonable.

defects.issue: Hands on the thigh are free-state mittens that look like they float above the leg.
defects.fix: Use flat hand state with the thigh surface normal so palms press on the thigh.

hip-flexor-lunge.summary: Half-kneeling stance is clean and well grounded in all views except front. The stretch is a slow ~12 cm forward pelvic shift with no torso change and half the frames held still, so at phone size it reads largely as a static pose.

defects.issue: The forward hip drive (~12 cm, pelvis only; chest and head move <3 cm vertically) is slow and uniform; the rear-hip opening that defines the stretch is not emphasised.
defects.fix: Add a slight posterior pelvic tilt and torso lift (3-5 cm) at the end of the shift, and lighten the rear thigh so the hip angle stands out.

defects.issue: Rear leg is hidden behind the front knee; reads as standing on one leg.
defects.fix: Geometry only.

kb-bent-row.summary: Staggered hinge with the left arm rowing reads in the three-quarter and left views; the supporting hand on the thigh is visible. From the right view the working arm is behind the torso, and the far-grey arm against the grey bell is low contrast.

defects.issue: The rowing arm and bell are fully occluded by the torso; only a grey edge shows, so the action disappears when orbited to that side.
defects.fix: Accept as geometry but keep the default azimuth on the working side; consider lightening the far-arm colour slightly (e.g. #9a9d92) so it separates from the bell (#b4b1a6 under shade).

defects.issue: Support forearm touches the thigh (-3.8 mm); the flat hand on the thigh is a free-state mitten that hovers rather than presses.
defects.fix: Use hand state 2 (flat) with a thigh surface normal for the support hand and move it 1 cm off the thigh surface.

kb-clean.summary: Single-arm clean from hinge to rack reads well in three-quarter and left views; the rack position is distinct. Free arm is visible. Minor forearm/thigh contact during the backswing.

defects.issue: In the backswing the working forearm cuts into the thigh (-13.7 mm) and the bell hides behind the near leg.
defects.fix: Move the hike path 2 cm medially/back so the forearm clears the thigh.

defects.issue: Rack: bell covers the hand and forearm, rack reads as a blob at the chest.
defects.fix: Rotate the bell to sit on the outer forearm (bell centre ~4 cm lateral) so the hand shows.

kb-curl.summary: Horns-grip curl reads well from the three-quarter and side views; elbows stay by the ribs, distinguishing it from the upright row. Bell slightly sinks into thighs at the bottom.

defects.issue: At the bottom the bell body penetrates the thighs (-8.7 mm), visible as the bell flattening against the legs.
defects.fix: Start the curl with the bell 1-2 cm further forward or slightly higher.

kb-deadlift.summary: Clear hip hinge with bell between the feet, good in side views; grips small but present. The bottom position has the upper arms sinking into the thighs and the 3/4 view packs knees, arms and bell into one cluster.

defects.issue: At the bottom both upper arms intersect the thighs (geometry -16.5 mm) and the near arm, knee and bell merge into one light blob; the hand-to-handle contact is hard to see.
defects.fix: Narrow the hand width on the handle less and push the knees slightly out (or the shoulders slightly forward over the bell) so arms hang inside the knees with >= 1 cm clearance.

defects.issue: Front view shows the bell on the floor hidden by hands and knees; reads as a squat.
defects.fix: No model change needed; keep default camera at az 30 and avoid front as a preset.

kb-getup.summary: A long, well-sequenced get-up whose standing and kneeling phases read clearly in the three-quarter and left views. The figure is small because the framing covers the whole 2 m floor path, and the floor phases are hard to parse from front and right views: the bell, vertical arm and bent knee merge.

defects.issue: Lying start seen from the feet: the bent knee and the vertical bell arm form one grey column, the head is hidden and the bell (grey) merges with the far grey arm.
defects.fix: Lighten the bell slightly or give it a darker outline-free silhouette against far-grey limbs; keep default camera from above-side (el 24) and avoid front.

defects.issue: Support hand on the floor and the posted elbow are hidden behind the torso; the floor contact that defines the step is not visible.
defects.fix: Move the default azimuth to show the support side (around -60) or raise elevation to ~30 deg in floor phases.

defects.issue: Figure occupies about 40-50% of the frame height when standing due to large bounds; small at phone size.
defects.fix: Frame from the per-phase footprint rather than the full-loop bounds, or reduce the distance multiplier for this clip.

kb-halo.summary: The circling of the bell around the head is recognisable, but the close upper-body crop makes the figure cramped: forearms pass across the face, the bell disappears behind the head for a quarter of the loop, and the hands on the horns are rarely legible.

defects.issue: The near forearm crosses in front of the face/chin and the bell sits beside the ear; head, arm and bell merge into one shape.
defects.fix: Widen the halo path 3-5 cm outward and raise it so the forearms pass at forehead height rather than across the face.

defects.issue: The bell is almost fully hidden behind the head at the back position; only the handle edge and hands show.
defects.fix: Raise the bell 4-6 cm behind the head or use a slightly higher default elevation (18-20 deg) so it stays visible over the crown.

defects.issue: cropBelow 0.96 crops at mid-thigh and the shirt fills a third of the frame, so the action (hands and bell) is small relative to the torso and close to the top edge.
defects.fix: Reduce crop zoom by ~15% or shift the framing target up so head and bell sit in the middle third.

kb-press.summary: Strict single-arm press from rack to lockout is clear from front and three-quarter; the free arm stays down. Overhead bell gets close to the top edge.

defects.issue: At lockout the bell sits ~25-30 px from the top of the 480 frame; slightly cramped.
defects.fix: Lower the framing target by ~4% of bounds height or increase distance multiplier from 1.3 to 1.35 for overhead clips.

defects.issue: Working arm is the far side; the overhead arm hides behind the head.
defects.fix: Geometry only; no change.

kb-pullover.summary: Standing pullover with horns grip from chest to behind the head reads in the three-quarter and side views. At the overhead/behind position the bell disappears behind the head in front view and the arms frame the head tightly.

defects.issue: Bell behind the head is hidden; arms around the head look like a hands-on-head pose.
defects.fix: Lower the bell less far behind the head (stop ~5 cm higher) so it stays visible above the crown.

defects.issue: Bell and hands are on the far side of the head; profile action is partly occluded.
defects.fix: Geometry only; default az 55 is fine.

kb-reverse-lunge.summary: Alternating step back to a kneeling lunge with the goblet bell reads well in three-quarter and side views; foot plant and knee drop are clear. Front view hides the rear leg.

defects.issue: The rear knee and shin are hidden behind the front leg; the pose reads as a shallow squat on one leg.
defects.fix: Keep front out of presets; consider a small default elevation (12-15 deg) so the rear shin shows behind the front foot.

defects.issue: 7.4 s for two reps is slow but acceptable; loop seam 8 mm is fine.
defects.fix: None required.

kb-side-bend.summary: Front and three-quarter show a clear lateral bend with the bell in the left hand and the other hand on the hip. Side views are almost static slivers (expected for a frontal-plane move). Bend amplitude is modest at phone size.

defects.issue: In profile the movement is nearly invisible; the bell just bobs a few centimetres.
defects.fix: No change to motion; consider front as default (current az 12 is fine).

defects.issue: Head tilts strongly with the trunk, which makes the bend read partly as a neck tilt.
defects.fix: Keep the head aligned with the thoracic spine (reduce extra neck side-flexion by ~half).

kb-side-lunge.summary: Wide-stance lateral shift is very clear in front and three-quarter; bell at chest stays readable. Side views collapse into a squat silhouette, as expected for a frontal-plane move.

defects.issue: In profile the straight leg is hidden behind the bent leg, so the lunge looks like a squat.
defects.fix: Default camera (az 20) is correct; no model change.

kb-snatch.summary: Hike, high pull and punch-through to lockout read clearly; the fast phases are appropriately quick (2.8 s). Head is hidden behind the arm in profile at lockout.

defects.issue: In profile the locked-out arm passes in front of the face, hiding the head; lockout bell 30 px from the top edge.
defects.fix: Angle the lockout 3-5 deg behind the ear (arm slightly back) and add a little top margin for overhead clips.

defects.issue: Wrist moves up to 139 mm per frame during the drop; at 30 fps this may strobe but is plausible for a snatch.
defects.fix: Confirm in real playback; if strobing, add two in-between frames to the drop arc.

kb-swing.summary: Hinge, hike and float to chest height read clearly in the side and three-quarter views; the bell and two-hand grip are legible at float. The hike phase is the weak point: forearms sink into the thighs and the bell disappears behind the near thigh, and the front view gives no sense of depth.

defects.issue: At the hike the bell is fully hidden behind the near thigh and both forearms cut into the thighs (geometry -16 mm), so the key backswing position shows hands vanishing between the legs with no bell.
defects.fix: Carry the hike path 3-4 cm lower/further back and widen the hand path so forearms clear the inner thighs (target clearance >= 0); keep the bell's centre below the knee line so it shows between the legs.

defects.issue: The bell at float sits directly in front of the chest and covers the hands and shirt; with no depth cue the float reads like an upright row.
defects.fix: Accept front as a secondary view but make sure the default camera (az 62) stays the app default; optionally add a 5-8 deg elevation to the default so the arm angle shows.

kb-upright-row.summary: Elbows flare high with the bell at the lower chest; front and three-quarter read clearly and differ from the curl because elbows lead. Side views are acceptable.

defects.issue: The bell at the chest covers both hands so the shared-handle grip is invisible at the top.
defects.fix: Lower the top position 2-3 cm or tilt the bell forward so the handle and both mittens stay above the bell body.

leg-raises.summary: Straight-leg raise to ~45 deg reads very clearly in side and three-quarter views with flat hands on the floor. Front view is the usual from-the-feet stack.

defects.issue: Raised legs hide the torso head-on.
defects.fix: Geometry only.

neck-extension.summary: Look-up extension is visible in side and three-quarter views. In the tight upper-body crop the thin neck rod under the large faceted head makes the head look like it hinges on a pin, and in profile the near arm covers the torso entirely.

defects.issue: Head pivots at the top of a thin cylinder; the bend looks like a lollipop tipping, not a neck extending.
defects.fix: Thicken the neck (radius ~0.06) and blend it into the shirt collar, or rotate the head about a pivot at C7 so the neck curve shows.

defects.issue: Extension is along the camera axis: the head just appears shorter.
defects.fix: Geometry only.

defects.issue: Near arm hides the shirt; figure is a white column.
defects.fix: Hang the arms slightly forward or abducted in upper-body clips.

neck-flexion.summary: Chin-to-chest flexion reads in side views; same thin-neck lollipop pivot as neck-extension, and the head touches the top edge of the side views at the start.

defects.issue: Upright head is clipped by or touching the top edge of the frame.
defects.fix: Lower the crop target or add 6-8% top margin in upper-body framing.

defects.issue: Head rotates on a thin neck stick; flexion looks mechanical.
defects.fix: Thicker neck blending into the collar; pivot lower.

oblique-twist.summary: Trunk rotation with hands clasped at chest reads from the high default camera (el 44) and in side views; in front view the rotation reads mostly as arms swinging side to side.

defects.issue: Shoulder rotation shows only as forearms sliding sideways; hips appear static, so the twist is ambiguous.
defects.fix: Show more shoulder-line change (rotate chest 5-10 deg further) and keep the clasped hands slightly further forward so the arm triangle rotates visibly.

defects.issue: Clasped hands are two mittens touching, merging with the chest.
defects.fix: Hold the clasp 8-10 cm in front of the sternum.

overhead-reach.summary: Arms sweep out and up to an interlaced overhead reach; the front and three-quarter views read well with a strong silhouette. The sweeps are fast (palm up to 134 mm/frame) between long holds, and the interlaced hands read as an X of crossed forearms rather than clasped fingers.

defects.issue: At the top the forearms cross into an X and the hands are two small mittens; interlaced fingers are not legible.
defects.fix: Bring the palms together without crossing the wrists (wrists 6-8 cm apart, palms pressed) or add a clasp hand state.

defects.issue: The arm sweep happens in roughly 0.3 s while 43% of frames are held; the motion feels like a jump between poses.
defects.fix: Lengthen the sweep to ~0.8 s each way and shorten the holds.

defects.issue: Raised hands come within ~15 px of the top edge.
defects.fix: Add top margin for overhead clips.

pike-pushup.summary: The inverted V is a strong side silhouette, but the press itself is small: the whole trunk (pelvis, chest and head together) sinks only ~11 cm, so the head-toward-floor action that defines the pike push-up barely shows. Front view is a tangle of arms and shirt.

defects.issue: Head and hips drop by the same 110 mm; the V just sinks rather than the head travelling toward the hands while the hips stay high.
defects.fix: Keep the pelvis height nearly fixed and bend the elbows so the head drops 20-25 cm, moving slightly forward of the hands.

defects.issue: Head-on, the shirt hides the head and arms form a frame; unreadable.
defects.fix: Geometry only.

plank.summary: Forearm plank from the toes is well drawn and reads in three-quarter and side views. The clip is 100% motionless for its 2 s loop, so in the app it looks like a frozen frame; there is no cue that this is a hold.

defects.issue: Zero joint movement in every frame; with a live renderer this can be mistaken for a stalled player.
defects.fix: Add a subtle breathing cycle (chest 3-5 mm, 4 s) or a timer UI cue; keep the body line fixed.

defects.issue: Head-on view shows only shoulders and forearms.
defects.fix: Geometry only.

plank-jump-ins.summary: Plank to crouch and back is recognisable in side views, but at the crouch the thighs pass through the upper arms (-47 mm) and legs and arms merge into one tangled block in the three-quarter view.

defects.issue: Knees and shins overlap and penetrate the arms; the landing feet sit between the hands so it is unclear which limbs support the body.
defects.fix: Land the feet outside the hands (stance ~10 cm wider than hand width) or slightly behind them, and lift the hips so the thighs clear the upper arms.

defects.issue: Knee travels up to 84 mm per frame with no visible airborne moment; the jump reads as a slide.
defects.fix: Lift both feet 4-6 cm during the jump for 3-4 frames.

power-pushup.summary: Explosive push-up with hands leaving the floor; clear in side views. Hands-off moment is short and the clip is a near duplicate of clapping-pushup.

defects.issue: Hands leave the floor briefly; at native size the gap under the hands is a few pixels.
defects.fix: Raise the flight peak 3-5 cm and hold it for 2-3 more frames so the air gap reads.

defects.issue: Identical to clapping-pushup outside the flight phase.
defects.fix: Differentiate the flight pose (hands open, wide) from the clap pose.

pseudo-planche.summary: Forward lean from a high plank reads in side views as shoulders travelling past the hands; heels lift. The lean (~21 cm) is visible but the start pose looks like a regular push-up plank, so differentiation depends on noticing the shoulder shift.

defects.issue: Hands stay under the shoulders' start point; at phone size the lean reads only as the body sliding forward.
defects.fix: Turn the hands slightly outward/backward (fingers toward feet) and keep the hands visibly behind the shoulders at the lean peak.

defects.issue: Head-on stack.
defects.fix: Geometry only.

pull-ups.summary: Wide overhand pull-up reads from front and three-quarter, with a clearly wider grip than chin-ups. Side views suffer the same post-through-body problem; the overhand vs underhand difference is subtle.

defects.issue: Frame post cuts through the figure in profile.
defects.fix: Offset posts behind the body plane or draw them thinner.

defects.issue: Head at top close to frame edge and overlapped by the bar.
defects.fix: Add top margin; let the chin clear the bar by 3-4 cm.

punches.summary: Fighting stance with jab and cross reads in side and three-quarter views; the 2 s loop gives brisk punches. Fists are tiny stubs barely wider than the forearm, and the front view points the punches at the camera.

defects.issue: The punching fist is a small cap at the end of the forearm; the guard hand is a thin grey rod by the face.
defects.fix: Scale the fist state ~1.3x (wider knuckle block) so it reads as a fist at phone size.

defects.issue: Punches extend toward the camera and disappear into foreshortening.
defects.fix: Geometry only; keep default az 75.

pushup.summary: Standard push-up from the toes with flat hands reads cleanly in side and three-quarter views with good depth (~24 cm chest travel).

defects.issue: Bottom position head-on shows only shoulders and elbows.
defects.fix: Geometry only.

quad-stretch.summary: Standing quad stretch with the free arm out for balance reads in side and three-quarter views. The foot is whipped up in about 0.5 s (toe up to 222 mm/frame, kicking out behind first), and the hand-on-foot grip is a blob where the hand sinks into the shin (-21 mm).

defects.issue: The foot swings out behind and up like a kick before reaching the hand.
defects.fix: Raise the heel along a tight arc close to the thigh over ~1 s, hand meeting the ankle on the way up.

defects.issue: Grasping hand, ankle and shoe merge into one blob and the hand penetrates the shin.
defects.fix: Use the grip state around the ankle (bar axis along the shin) and offset the hand 2 cm to the lateral side.

raised-leg-pushup.summary: Push-up with an alternating raised leg reads clearly in side and three-quarter views; the lifted leg is well separated from the support leg by near/far shading.

defects.issue: Head-on the raised leg pokes up above the head and the push-up depth is invisible.
defects.fix: Geometry only.

defects.issue: Seam step 8.5 mm vs median 22.6 mm; fine.
defects.fix: None.

reclined-twist.summary: Supine knee rolls with arms in a T. From the default feet-end camera the knees tipping side to side are visible, but the roll is modest and in side views the motion is just a slight knee lean. The large floor disc is clipped by the frame edges.

defects.issue: Knee drop reads as a small lean of the bent legs; the spinal twist is not visible.
defects.fix: Increase the roll so the knees travel to ~45 deg off vertical and let the far shoulder stay pinned (arm flat) to show the twist.

defects.issue: Floor disc (sized to the T-arms footprint) runs off both sides of every frame.
defects.fix: Clamp the floor disc to the framed width or include it in the framing bounds.

reverse-crunches.summary: Knees pulled toward the chest with the pelvis curling up reads well in side and three-quarter views; flat hands on the floor are visible.

defects.issue: Thighs cover the torso at the top; the pelvic curl is hidden.
defects.fix: Optional: raise default elevation 4-6 deg.

reverse-lunge.summary: Alternating bodyweight reverse lunge with arms forward reads clearly in three-quarter and side views; foot plant and rear-knee drop are obvious. Long 9.5 s loop with pauses; front view hides the rear leg.

defects.issue: Rear leg hidden behind the front leg.
defects.fix: Geometry only.

defects.issue: 9.5 s for two reps with 12% held frames may feel sluggish in playback (seam 9 mm, smooth).
defects.fix: Consider ~7 s total; verify in playback.

seated-knee.summary: Alternating seated knee lift on a chair reads well in three-quarter and side views; the chair is clean and the hands rest on the thighs.

defects.issue: Chair back and legs overlap the figure's far leg, slightly cluttering the profile.
defects.fix: Geometry only; default az 44 is good.

shoulder-circle.summary: Backward shoulder rolls in a tight upper-body crop. The motion is carried almost entirely by the convex shirt hull changing shape (it tilts into a lozenge at 0.625-0.875), so it reads as the shirt flickering rather than shoulders circling; arms barely change.

defects.issue: Shirt hull deforms asymmetrically and its facets jump, which looks like a rendering glitch.
defects.fix: Anchor the shirt's shoulder points to a smoothed shoulder position or add shoulder caps (spheres at the shoulder joint) so the roll is shown by the arm root moving, not by the hull reshaping.

defects.issue: The near arm covers the torso; the circular path of the shoulder is not visible.
defects.fix: Show a small elbow bend/arm swing following the shoulder, or slightly abduct the arms so the shoulder joint is exposed.

shoulder-taps.summary: High plank with alternating hand-to-opposite-shoulder taps reads in side and three-quarter views. The tapping hand merges with the head and shoulder, and the body does not visibly shift weight (validator ZMP failure).

defects.issue: Tapping hand and forearm overlap the face and shoulder; the tap contact is a blob.
defects.fix: Tap slightly lower on the shoulder front, keep the elbow lower, and drop the head slightly so the hand stays visible.

defects.issue: No lateral weight shift toward the support hand.
defects.fix: Shift the pelvis/chest 4-6 cm toward the support side during each tap.

side-bend.summary: Alternating side bend with overhead reach reads clearly from the front with a strong arc. Arm transitions are fast (palm up to 124 mm/frame) and the reaching hand comes close to the top edge.

defects.issue: Overhead hand within ~15 px of the top edge.
defects.fix: Add top margin for overhead clips.

defects.issue: The arm drops through the T position quickly between bends, making the sweep feel abrupt.
defects.fix: Ease the arm descent over ~0.6 s.

defects.issue: Frontal-plane bend is invisible in profile.
defects.fix: Geometry only.

side-leg-raises.summary: Standing lateral leg raise alternating sides reads clearly in front and three-quarter views; arms slightly out for balance give a good silhouette.

defects.issue: In profile the raised leg is hidden behind the standing leg.
defects.fix: Geometry only.

side-neck.summary: Ear-to-shoulder side flexion reads from the front and three-quarter views. Same thin-neck pivot issue as other neck clips, and the head touches the top of the frame in side views.

defects.issue: Head crown touches the top frame edge.
defects.fix: Add top margin in upper-body crops.

defects.issue: Head tilts on a thin rod; the neck has no visible side curve.
defects.fix: Thicker neck blended into the collar; pivot lower.

side-step.summary: Sideways step-together and return reads well from the front and three-quarter views with clear foot lift and plant; profile views hide the lateral travel, as expected.

defects.issue: Lateral travel is along the camera axis; only a slight knee bend shows.
defects.fix: Geometry only; default az 18 is right.

side-to-side-chops.summary: Clasped-hands chops from side to side. At normal elevations the hands only slide horizontally at chest height, so there is no visible high-to-low chopping diagonal; the clip relies on the steep default camera (el 58) to read as rotation. Hands are a small clasped knot.

defects.issue: Hands stay at chest height and move sideways; reads like a gentle arm sway rather than a chop.
defects.fix: Give the hands a diagonal path (shoulder height on one side to hip height on the other) with trunk rotation, or reduce the default elevation once the path has vertical travel.

defects.issue: Profile shows arms extended forward with little change.
defects.fix: Geometry only.

defects.issue: Seam step 27 mm equals the largest per-frame step; continuous but no ease at the turn.
defects.fix: Verify in playback; add ease-in/out at the direction reversals.

sit-stand.summary: Chair sit-to-stand with arms reaching forward reads very well in three-quarter and side views; the chair is clean and the seat contact is clear. Head flicks forward quickly (face up to 66 mm/frame) at lift-off and landing.

defects.issue: Head nods forward abruptly at lift-off and landing.
defects.fix: Keep the head aligned with the trunk and spread the nod over 8-10 frames.

defects.issue: Chair back sits behind the figure and frames it; fine, but the seat contact is hidden.
defects.fix: Geometry only.

sit-ups.summary: Bent-knee sit-up with hands behind the head reads clearly in side and three-quarter views; the torso rise is large. Elbows and hands form a clump around the head at the top.

defects.issue: Hands behind the head and elbows merge with the head into one blob.
defects.fix: Point the elbows wider (out to the sides) so the head silhouette stays separate.

defects.issue: From the feet the knees hide the torso at the bottom.
defects.fix: Geometry only.

spiderman-pushup.summary: Push-up with alternating knee to elbow reads from the high default camera and side views. At the bottom the driving thigh passes into the upper arm (-18.6 mm) and the knee and elbow merge in the three-quarter view.

defects.issue: Knee overlaps and penetrates the upper arm; which knee is driving is hard to tell.

defects.issue: Knee travels up to 89 mm per frame.

squat.summary: Bodyweight squat with arms rising forward for balance reads cleanly from three-quarter and side views; feet stay planted. Front view shows depth only as shrinking height.

defects.issue: Arms point at the camera and the hip hinge is invisible head-on.
defects.fix: Geometry only.

stacked-pushup.summary: Push-up with one foot stacked on the other. The push-up is clear, but the stacked feet are only visible as the two legs merging into one in side views; at phone size this looks like a standard push-up.

defects.issue: Stacked legs overlap exactly in profile; the top foot resting on the bottom heel is not legible.

defects.issue: Only one foot shows head-on; can read as a one-leg push-up.
defects.fix: Geometry only.

staggered-pushup.summary: Push-up with one hand forward and one back. Push-up depth reads well; the stagger is visible in the front and three-quarter views but subtle in profile.

defects.issue: In profile the far hand is hidden, so the stagger is not visible.
defects.fix: Increase the stagger to ~25 cm between hands or use the three-quarter default (present az 38 is fine).

standing-knee.summary: Alternating standing bent-knee lift to hip height reads clearly in three-quarter and side views with a planted standing foot.

defects.issue: Knee lift points at the camera; reads only as a shorter leg.
defects.fix: Geometry only; default az 65 is correct.

defects.issue: Seam step 8 mm, smooth.
defects.fix: None.

superman.summary: Prone lift of arms, chest and legs, then hold. Side views show the shallow banana shape, but the figure is a thin strip, the lift is small (chest ~6 cm, feet ~18 cm), half the frames are held, and the floor disc runs off the frame. Front view (from the feet) is unreadable.

defects.issue: Lift amplitude is a few pixels at phone size; the hold looks static.
defects.fix: Frame floor-lying clips tighter and raise the default elevation to ~20 deg; increase chest lift to ~10 cm if form allows.

defects.issue: Floor disc wider than the frame, cut at both sides.
